CustomField.description: Formula to display the tier icon
CustomField.formula: IF( CONTAINS(UPPER(TEXT(Customer_Category__c )),"GOLD"),IMAGE("/resource/QACTierGold", 'QACTierGold', 35, 105), IF( CONTAINS(UPPER(TEXT(Customer_Category__c )),"SILVER"),IMAGE("/resource/QACTierSilver", 'QACTierSilver', 35, 105), IF( CONTAINS(UPPER(TEXT(Customer_Category__c )),"BRONZE"),IMAGE("/resource/QACTierBronze", 'QACTierBronze', 35, 105), IF( CONTAINS(UPPER(TEXT(Customer_Category__c )),"WHITE"),IMAGE("/resource/QACTierWhite", 'QACTierWhite', 35, 105), IF( CONTAINS(UPPER(TEXT(Customer_Category__c )),"RED"),IMAGE("/resource/QACTierRed", 'QACTierRed', 35, 105), IF( CONTAINS(UPPER(TEXT(Customer_Category__c )),"PLATINUM"),IMAGE("/resource/QACTierPlatinum", 'QACTierPlatinum', 35, 105), "") ) ) ) ))
CustomField.label: Tier
